authorityRule: For the generated fallback there is exactly one active manufactured window-lock system: FacadeSashLatchHardware, governed by facade_sash_latch_contract.json and the sash-latch metadata-authority chain. Any second active renderer-bearing sash/crescent/window-lock hierarchy outside that authorized root is a hard failure, even if its individual dimensions or material values look plausible. The 60 HD_WindowHandle_ fallback renderers remain provenance only and must stay disabled. Authored danchi replacement may omit the generated latch root, but may not leave any generated candidate sash-lock hierarchy active.
constructionReasoning: One two-panel aluminum sliding sash receives one crescent lock/receiver assembly at the meeting stiles. Installing a second independently generated lock at the same aperture would be mechanically nonsensical, risk floating/interpenetrating hero geometry and create immediately repeated dark/specular motifs across all 30 windows. Uniqueness is therefore a construction invariant, not merely a naming preference.
renderBoundaryRule: Validation is read-only and fail-closed before QA4K_, QATemporal_, QAPreparedTemporal_ and CameraType.Reflection culls. The gate delegates to the existing physical latch + metadata-authority validation, then rejects any active renderer-bearing candidate hierarchy that is not a descendant of FacadeSashLatchHardware. It performs no repair inside render callbacks.
lookdevBrief: Native 3840x2160 frontal and 35-degree oblique evidence must show one lock silhouette per two-panel window, never doubled or offset. The 100-percent sash-latch crop must resolve a single base/pivot/crescent/keeper system with no second dark plate, overlapping lever or duplicate specular centroid. Grazing-light and temporal oblique evidence must be checked for doubled highlights, z-fight, shimmer or an apparent extra lock as LODs cross-fade.
failureInjection: Create an active Danchi/SashCrescentLocks hierarchy with a MeshRenderer while FacadeSashLatchHardware remains active; formal pre-cull must fail.
Create an active nested CrescentLockExtra hierarchy outside FacadeSashLatchHardware with an LODGroup or MeshRenderer; formal pre-cull must fail.
Rename a duplicate to WindowLockExperimental and leave it active; the candidate-token scan must fail.
Move FacadeSashLatchHardware away from direct Danchi parentage; validation must fail.
Enable any of the 60 HD_WindowHandle_ legacy fallback renderers; delegated physical latch validation must fail.
Delete the authorized root for generated fallback; validation must fail rather than creating it during formal cull.
Use an authored danchi replacement while leaving generated FacadeSashLatchHardware or another candidate lock hierarchy active; validation must fail.
Set automaticVisualPoints above zero or renderVerificationPending=false before real native-4K review; contract validation must fail.
